evals.prompt: Write the PR description for this diff. It bumps django 5.2.3 to 5.2.4 and celery 5.5.1 to 5.5.2, and removes the `task_remote_tracebacks` setting from settings.py because celery 5.5.2 dropped it. The full test suite passed locally.
evals.expected_output: A title line, two or three bullets, one test line, and the Co-Authored-By footer. No paragraphs, no section headers, no sentence about what was preserved or not changed.
expectations: The description has no em dash, curly quote, or the words quietly, robust, comprehensive, leverage, seamless
The description uses bullets rather than a prose paragraph for the changes
The description does not contain the words previously, preserved, unchanged, untouched, or the phrase 'This PR'
The description ends with the exact footer line 'Co-Authored-By: 🤖 Claude [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code), reviewed by the author'
The description is under 12 lines including the footer

evals.prompt: A reviewer commented on my PR: 'Why was `build_payload` inlined here? It looked reusable.' I inlined it because it had a single call site. Draft the reply I should post.
evals.expected_output: One or two sentences stating the reason (single call site), with no thanks, apology, or closing offer.
expectations: The reply is at most two sentences
The reply states that the helper had one call site
The reply contains none of: 'Great', 'thanks', 'apologies', 'let me know', 'absolutely right', 'as suggested'
The reply has no em dash

evals.prompt: Humanize this: 'This change migrates the HTTP client from requests to httpx. Previously, all calls went through a shared requests.Session; now they leverage an httpx.AsyncClient for a more robust, seamless experience. The retry logic has been carefully preserved and the sync call sites in sync.py were intentionally left unchanged — no behavioral changes are expected.'
evals.expected_output: A rewrite that states the current state (async HTTP via httpx.AsyncClient; sync.py still uses requests) without narrating the old behavior or what was preserved, and a short list of the removed tells.
expectations: The rewrite does not contain previously, preserved, unchanged, leverage, robust, seamless, or an em dash
The rewrite mentions httpx.AsyncClient and that sync.py still uses requests
The rewrite does not open with 'This change' or 'This PR'
Running `node scripts/prose-lint.js --mode prose` on the rewrite exits 0
